archetype: Archetype 5: Luxury & Depth mixed with Grid Borders (The Technical Look). A premium, deeply immersive dark mode dashboard.

typography.strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' & 'Swiss Brutalist' fusion. Radical contrast.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use Crystal Glassmorphism for sticky headers and modals (backdrop-blur-2xl, bg-white/5, 1px border-white/10). Use Solid Backgrounds for dashboard cards.
visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton. Grid items should use border-r and border-b with border-white/5 to create a structured 'Technical' look.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Diffuse ambient shadows only. shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)] for elevated elements.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlays in empty spaces or the login background to kill the digital flatness.

components.cards: Flat solid surfaces. Sharp or slightly rounded edges (max rounded-md). 1px subtle border, no heavy box shadows by default.
components.buttons: Tactical minimalism. Pure white background with black text for primary actions. Hover states should translate-y slightly and add a subtle glow.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Form/Input components. High contrast focus rings. Inputs must have solid dark backgrounds, never fully transparent.
components.navigation: Sticky sidebar or top header with crystal glassmorphism. Must have solid structure so text never collides with scrolling media.
components.toasts: Sonner is mandatory. Position bottom-right. Dark theme matching.
components.calendar: Shadcn custom calendar for scheduling. Strict grid alignment.
components.data_visualization: Recharts for analytics. Monochrome or platform-specific colored lines, minimalist axes, no heavy grid lines.

grids_layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing: p-6 or p-8 inside structural containers. Container gaps of gap-6 or gap-8.
grids_layouts.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid (MODE B). Base: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Summary widgets col-span-1. Charts col-span-2 or 3.
grids_layouts.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Center only if tension requires it. Left-align dense data, labels, and paragraph blocks.
grids_layouts.mobile_first: Images max-h-[80vh] on mobile. Stack grids to grid-cols-1 on small viewports.

motion.interactions: Hover states must have transitions (e.g., transition: background-color 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease). Do NOT use 'transition: all'.
motion.modals: Scale up slightly (0.95 to 1) and fade in. Glassmorphism blur animates in.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast on interactive states. Hover state color must be a lighter hue. Focus rings must be high contrast.
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid based on role (e.g., data-testid='post-submit-button').
accessibility.motion_preference: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all framer-motion animations.

media.treatment: Images must have subtle overlays if text sits on top (bg-black/50 max). Use pure, high-quality images.
media.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for general UI. Platform logos should use 'react-icons' (e.g., FaYoutube, FaTwitter).

3d_libraries.strategy: Not strictly necessary for the core dashboard, but can use 'TSParticles' with a very subtle dark mesh/stars config for the Google Login background to add depth.

login_background.description: Abstract sleek dark gradient for the authentication page background.

thumbnail_sample_1.description: Sunset urban skyline, used as a mock thumbnail in the recent posts / history table.

thumbnail_sample_2.description: Minimalist modern workspace, used as a mock thumbnail in the composer queue.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a unified dashboard handling multi-platform social media publishing.
Implement pure HTML/Tailwind for layouts and Shadcn components for complex interactions (Forms, Modals, Calendars).
Focus heavily on the 'Content Composer' allowing media uploads and per-platform metadata toggles.
Ensure 'Content Calendar' utilizes robust grid logic.
Provide empty states with high-contrast, beautiful typography when no posts are scheduled.
Never use via.placeholder.com. Use the provided image URLs.
Maintain the strict 'Grid Borders' tech look for the dashboard layout (visible 1px borders between widgets).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic 'AI slop'. Prioritize optical alignment and generous padding.
Never use dark colors as gradients. Use solid dark backgrounds.
Avoid generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical or heavily structured grid layouts.
Create depth through layered z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism (12-24px blur with 1px borders).
NEVER use 'transition: all'. Explicitly define transitions (e.g., transform, opacity).
DO NOT center align the app container. Text and forms should align naturally (left).
Use modern pill-shaped or sharp-edged buttons with micro-interactions.
Never use AI emoji characters (🤖🧠💭) for icons. Use lucide-react.
Include 'data-testid' on ALL buttons, links, inputs, and interactive components.
Shadcn Tablists must override h-9 with h-auto to prevent text cutoff on multi-line.
Never use complete transparent backgrounds for elements overlapping content (e.g., sticky navs, dropdowns). Always use solid or glass surfaces.
